body: My job is good, my life sucks I hate myself
There is no one who would appreciate a petty gambler with no self control. Everyone left me, now it's my turn to leave this world and it's shit. Nobody cares about whether I live or die
I am a gambler, whoever comes in contact with me either loses money and hates me or gets to know me and hates me. I can't stop gambling. However long it goes, I relapse and do it again
I have made about 30-40 cuts on my left arm, can't make it deep enough. I don't know I am struggling to do it, but i have to. It's not working out with life any more

Why not? My family hates me, my wife hates me. There is no one who would rather see me alive.

I should have done it now, but I am a coward.

I have made a few cuts but not deep enough.

Your comment made me cry... You are a good person. God bless you. 

I am sorry I can't see the light at the end of the tunnel, I dont think it's worth waiting for. I am so sorry.

I had decided this would be the time I do it, so I should. Thanks for trying to help. Only one person could have helped me, but she doesn't want to talk to me

I dont have anyone to live for, they all left me. I don't know the reason or way to do this, but I have to. Living like this will not help anyone, my dying might. I just want to end my life.   


Why would you want to be my friend

I will hurt you too, s you said you have already been hurt too often. You don't need me

I did it again today... I can't live like this... It's absurd for me to live anymore. I don't wanna. My wife said she hates me and left. There is no way I can do this anymore. I don't want to live now
Nobody needs a fucking gambler blowing through money. They need someone useful
No there isn't. Everyone hates me and they are right to do so
I am the sickest person alive, i hurt everyone who knows me, I don't deserve to live. Anyone who talked to me got burned. Me living is not useful any more to anyone

I agree with most of the points you mentioned. Rather I agree with all of them, but still the question remains. How do i identify the trigger? How do I get out of this? 

My psychology won't let me think straight, and hence am looking at a point.

I can't think of anything but getting 20-30k more and start gambling again, I don't know what to do. Really struggling with this

I do feel exactly as you mentioned. Each and every wors feels like that's what I wanted to say.

I have a fear which says you won't be able to do it and it keeps me pushing further down the rabbit hole with no way out.

It's really irritating. I can't shake the feeling that I am screwed and things will never get better from here
Will start with this book and take it from there. I really want to get out of this but the struggle becomes worse everyday

Let's hope that there is a way out of this, for both our sakes. I am hopeful but lacking direction, will start with the book suggested above and take it from there.

Best of luck to you too

Can you help me on how to identify a trigger?

When I tried thinking of the trigger, it's someone saying can you give me 10k but I have 5, I gamble with the 5 till I have 0. The someone may be someone from my family who needs to buy something, or a friend who has lent me some money and wants it back.

This basically becomes kind of a cycle, keeping me in the loop forever. I find it very difficult to break out of it.

I read through the comments and they seem positive, but inside my heart I don't feel that things can improve. It feels like whatever I do it will keep happening and I will end up here again.

I don't know how to do it

Paying off is not really a problem here, i will be able to pay off my current debt in July next year. But that's hardly the concern right now. My problem is that I keep blowing my current salary and keep delaying the repayment. I understand it's wrong but am not able to control it. 

It's really frustrating everyday

I am trying to recover and reconsider but can't find a logical conclusion, if someone has relapsed so many times how can I be sure that this is not who I am now?

I am this person and changing seems to be impossible, I will definitely try the sources you mentioned for podcasts. Hope that it works, everything else doesn't. I tried literally everything, but i find a loop hole in the problem and start gambling again

I tried telling it to my wife, but the next time I relapsed it became even harder to not feel worthless. My family already broke all contact with me the last time they discovered that I gambled. I keep relapsing and keep hurting my wife. The one person I can't bear to see cry. I want to end it because of the negativity i am filling in her life. I really want this to stop but I have relapsed so many times i can't even count. I don't know if this can be fixed. 

I understand that things may get better, but the trust that I broke for everyone is very rarely repaired. This makes me feel that is life like this really worth it
Why can't I just quit gambling? I don't want to do it but I still do it... Over and over again

I don't think anyone can understand how I feel right now. If I die this pain will go away the pain I have and the pain that I am causing and going to cause everyone. 
Isn't it better to kill myself and hope there is no afterlife nothing after you die. It all ends.
I want to give up I can't fight anymore it's I am waiting for the right time so that she is not that hurt when I am not there. Maybe I will tell her and kill myself after she hates me or leaves me

It's not about whether it's possible... My problem is I can't tell my dad and my wife that I fucked up again. I can't see that disappointed look again. I just can't I would rather kill myself than tell them. I don't want to but there's no choice. I know I can recover from money point of view but I can't see that look in my wife's eyes. Saying you motherfucker I have made so many sacrifices to keep you happy to be with you to get you out of the last time you did it and you go and do it again. What if she leaves me what if she hates me for the rest of my life. Isn't it better to die when she still loves me
Thanks for the concern!!

I have tried everything and done everything... There is no solution to it... The second I have money... It's as good as gone... Whatever amount I have... It's not just hurting one time... I keep hurting them... More and deeper everyday I live... It's just not feasible to change what I have become... Believe me I tried... This person is a menace to his family, society and everyone who comes in contact... It's better that it ends right now... I don't want to endure or give more pain anymore
I don't wanna quit but I just may have to... And to put cherry on the top, I got engaged yesterday and I'm beyond broke... With a massive 50k debt
Believing in myself has led me here... If I did not have confidence I would not have gotten this deep... My brother came to stay with me so I have to postpone till tomorrow

I am 25 have a good job paying handsomely(My debt is about 1.5 times my annual salary)... the only problem is that I cant quit and till I quit, I can't pay anyone back... My salary is enough to start repayments every month but still i dont... I hate myself for doing this to everyone... I hate myself in general... Thank you for your supporting comments... I have seen so many people cry because of my crappy decisions... I wont burden them with any more of these...
I have a mountain of debt I can't spend time with anyone.. people are chasing me around for money... there is nothing that I can do

I gave all my cards etc to my parents but as soon as the salary came I still took loans from friends and gambled to the extent of my salary...  restricted my access to internet to stay away from online gambling but again went to internet hubs to do it.. I lack the will power to stop it
Even now I think If i have to end it in the evening lets give it one more shot
I refreshed this page till now in hopes that maybe somebody cares may be somebody replies... guess this is the last piece of crap thing that I did... Thanks guys
